Pan Fried Chicken Strips
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, December 19, 2009 - 11:41pm

Ingredients




2 tablespoons olive oil
2 lbs. chicken breasts, skinned, boned and cut into ½ inch wide strips
2 cloves garlic, crushed
6 green onions, chopped
4 tablespoons Marsala wine
2 tablespoons lemon juice
Pepper (and salt, if desired)

Preparation

1 Heat large frying pan. Add oil, chicken strips, garlic and green onions. Saute over high heat until chicken is lightly browned and tender. Remove from pan. Add marsala and lemon juice. Allow the liquid to reduce for a moment. Return chicken to hot pan. Add peppers. Serve immediately.
